title: Forethought: Verifiable Reasoning from Neurosymbolic Primitive Programming
abstract: arXiv:2607.04096v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Modern agentic workflows decompose user requests into sequences of tool calls with correctly resolved parameters, the results of which are processed through reasoning traces in the language model's context window. The prevailing route to improving such reasoning is test-time scaling, which trains models to search over long chains of thought; but the resulting capability is entangled in model weights, cannot be checked step by step, and is costly at inference. We present Forethought, a neurosymbolic reasoning system built from a library of symbolic and neural primitives composed through a typed domain-specific language. The results are reasoning programs: concrete representations of the model's work, in which every step carries an output contract that is checked at design time and enforced at execution time. translated_title: Forethought：基于神经符号原语编程的可验证推理
translated_abstract: 现代智能体工作流将用户请求分解为一系列参数被正确解析的工具调用，其结果则通过语言模型上下文窗口中的推理轨迹加以处理。提升这类推理能力的主流路径是测试时扩展，即训练模型在长思维链上进行搜索；但由此获得的能力纠缠于模型权重之中，无法逐步检查，且推理时代价高昂。我们提出了 Forethought，一个神经符号推理系统，它由符号与神经原语库组成，并通过一种带类型的领域特定语言进行组合。其产物是“推理程序”：即模型工作的具体化表示，其中每一步都带有输出契约，该契约在设计时被检查、在执行时被强制执行。符号步骤的正确性由构造天然保证，而学习得到的步骤则经过契约检查与实证验证，从而提供显式的……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: Forethought 提出一种神经符号推理系统，通过类型化领域特定语言将符号与神经原语组合成每一步都携带可验证输出契约的“推理程序”，在设计时检查、在执行时强制执行，从而实现可验证且可审计的智能体推理，摆脱了对不可检查的长思维链的依赖。
en_tdlr: Forethought introduces a neurosymbolic reasoning system that composes symbolic and neural primitives into "reasoning programs" via a typed domain-specific language, where every step carries an output contract checked at design time and enforced at execution time, yielding verifiable reasoning for agentic workflows.
